label: prf:corrected-markov-trace
title: Proof of corrected markov trace
html:
Proof

By the Markov property (Jones–Markov trace), applying \mathrm{tr}_M to \sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0:

  1. \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0) = z \cdot \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1 \sigma_0) (Markov property on rightmost \sigma_0, which has maximal index in the word)

  2. \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_1 \sigma_0) = z \cdot \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_0) (Markov property on \sigma_1)

  3. \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_0) = z (single generator)

Therefore \mathrm{tr}_M(\sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0) = z^3.

The vertex volume product formula assumes that the Hecke reduction of each generator is independent — this holds when generators are non-adjacent (commuting), but fails for the trefoil \sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0 where \sigma_0 and \sigma_1 satisfy the Yang–Baxter relation \sigma_0 \sigma_1 \sigma_0 = \sigma_1 \sigma_0 \sigma_1.

Impact

With \mathrm{tr}_M(e^-) = z^3:

  • The Gram matrix is corrected
  • The mass ordering \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{n}} > \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{p}} is restored (mass ordering)
  • The confinement LP solution is modified (confinement LP)
